channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Chauncey Billups | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Chauncey Billups from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Chauncey Billups
item.description:
More from Lillard on Chauncey Billups:

“It was tough for me. I didn't even think about it from a basketball standpoint... I just felt bad for him having to experience that and that it had come to that.”

Damian Lillard on Chauncey Billups, Apr 30, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jrue Holiday on Chauncey Billups
item.description:
The Celtics got Holiday, who proved critical to their championship run in 2024.

“Chauncey really did me a solid the first time I was traded here, just being able to see things through my lens and ask me what I wanted,”

Jrue Holiday on Chauncey Billups, Oct 30, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Chauncey Billups
item.description:
Omari Sankofa II:JB Bickerstaff on Chauncey Billups:

“He’s a friend of mine. I’ve known him since I was in seventh grade. I care about him immensely and I hate to see what he’s going through right now… everyone needs to allow the due process to happen and then obviously judgements can be made.”

JB Bickerstaff on Chauncey Billups, Oct 26, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Chauncey Billups, Terry Rozier
item.description:
Joel Lorenzi:Billy Donovan on yday’s Chauncey Billups + Terry Rozier arrests:

“I was really, really surprised when that stuff came out. Certainly expect that everybody’s innocent until proven guilty.… obviously respected (Billups) as a player and winning a championship and all the things he’s accomplished as a player, and the job he was doing in Portland. Just surprised and saddened by all of it. “I’m sure we don’t have all the details, there’s probably more to come out. But it’s just sad that they’re dealing with that personally as human beings and that the league is dealing with that as well.”

Billy Donovan on Chauncey Billups, Terry Rozier, Oct 24, 2025. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Derrick White on Chauncey Billups
item.description:
“I saw Chauncey (Billups) do it and I know it’s possible. Hopefully one of these kids sees me and what I’ve managed to accomplish and they’ll think it’s possible to reach their dreams, whatever that might be.”

Derrick White on Chauncey Billups, Aug 2, 2025. Source: Colorado Springs Gazette.

item.title: Jrue Holiday on Chauncey Billups
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Jrue Holiday on playing for Chauncey Billups:

“I'm excited. I've always been a big fan of Chauncey. I'm a little older than these young guys, so got to watch Chauncey play in his prime,especially Detroit, growing up a Lakers fan. Being able to be coached by a Hall of Fame player is pretty cool.”

Jrue Holiday on Chauncey Billups, Jul 29, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Matisse Thybulle on Chauncey Billups
item.description:
Billups receiving a contract extension increased Thybulle’s confidence in the future.

“Chauncey getting his extension is really exciting and definitely makes me optimistic for running it back with these guys,”

Matisse Thybulle on Chauncey Billups, Apr 18, 2025. Source: Oregonian.

item.title: Deni Avdija on Chauncey Billups
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Deni Avdija on Billups extension:

“I've had a lot of fun playing for Chauncey. He's a winner. He's a competitor. I'm happy.”

Deni Avdija on Chauncey Billups, Apr 13, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Shaedon Sharpe on Chauncey Billups
item.description:
Shaedon Sharpe on Chauncey Billups telling him he was moving to the bench:

“It was a good convo. He basically told me what I needed to do, and today I think I took a big step in doing what he said. So I’ve just got to continue to do that.”

Shaedon Sharpe on Chauncey Billups, Jan 20, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Sam Mitchell on Chauncey Billups, Terrell Brandon
item.description:
“And I said, ‘Flip, I don’t know him. But why don’t you give him a chance?’ So, when he got here, Chauncey told me that when he was in Boston, Toronto and Denver, they gave up on him as a point guard and they just told him just come in and try to score. So that’s what he did.“And then when he came to Minnesota, I said, ‘Dude, if you really want to learn how to play the position, and if you really want to change how people think of you, you see that guy right there, Terrell Brandon, watch everything he does and talk to him. He’s a pure point guard …’ Chauncey told me, ‘I want to play the position. No one has ever taught me the position.’”

Sam Mitchell on Chauncey Billups, Terrell Brandon, Oct 11, 2024. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Matisse Thybulle on Chauncey Billups
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Matisse Thybulle on Chauncey Billups:

“He has an ability to create understanding for players across the board. We have guys who have played 10 years and multiple guys that can’t buy alcoholand he has a way to explain things in a way that everyone can grasp it.”

Matisse Thybulle on Chauncey Billups, Apr 15, 2024. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Scoot Henderson on Chauncey Billups
item.description:
“Taking me out of situations where I’ve messed up a couple times. That’s his way of letting me know, ‘Take a deep breath and when you get back out there, turn it up a notch.’I appreciate it a lot, having a coach like that and a mentor like that. Seeing other players’ development, you don’t see that a lot. Having Chauncey on my side as a head coach is great to have.”

Scoot Henderson on Chauncey Billups, Feb 16, 2024. Source: rosegardenreport.com.

item.title: Anfernee Simons on Chauncey Billups
item.description:
“He said it about the beginning of the game, and in the beginning of the game, I try to get everyone going. So it could be something about me or just something in general. And even if it was about me, he’s just challenging me. Like I told Chauncey the first time I met him: Coach me. Be hard. That’s all I know and all I want.”

Anfernee Simons on Chauncey Billups, Dec 27, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Matisse Thybulle on Chauncey Billups
item.description:
“I think some coaches may say that, just so they can get those little personal jabs in there to disguise it, but Chauncey is straight up. He’s really honest.”

Matisse Thybulle on Chauncey Billups, Dec 6, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Scoot Henderson on Chauncey Billups
item.description:
learned during a recent dinner.

“I asked him, honestly, like, ‘How does it feel to be Chauncey Billups?’”

Scoot Henderson on Chauncey Billups, Jul 7, 2023. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Chauncey Billups, Scoot Henderson
item.description:
Kerry Eggers:More Joe Cronin on Dame and Scoot:

“It’s a possibility those two can blend well together. They can complement each other. We’ll see how Chauncey decides how to use them. I don’t know if he’ll use (Henderson) as a backup or a starter, or swing him, but basketball is about talent.”

Joe Cronin on Chauncey Billups, Scoot Henderson, Jun 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.

item.title: Scoot Henderson on Chauncey Billups
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Scoot Henderson:

“I'm gonna pick Chauncey's brain so much, he might get annoyed. I'm gonna learn so much from him.”

Scoot Henderson on Chauncey Billups, Jun 22, 2023. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Chauncey Billups
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Damian Lillard on this offseason:

“I feel how I feel about Chauncey, I feel how I feel about Joe. The optimism is there but it's time to get the work done.”

Damian Lillard on Chauncey Billups, Apr 9, 2023. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Chauncey Billups, Shaedon Sharpe
item.description:
Law Murray:Tyronn Lue on Shaedon Sharpe:

“He's gotten way better defensively. And then offensively, the game is slowing down for him...just talking to Chauncey about him last couple of days, he's really excited about this young kid and how he's been playing, how he's matured and grown.”

Tyronn Lue on Chauncey Billups, Shaedon Sharpe, Apr 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Chauncey Billups
item.description:
Lue, who played in the last NBA regular-season game in Seattle with the Dallas Mavericks in 2008, played an instrumental role in getting the Clippers to Seattle for the preseason.

“Something we talked about me and Chauncey, just talked about in the summertime about just trying to get into the same city and we could have a few days of training camp and play some games and kind of be together to hang out, and we said ‘What better place than Seattle?‘”

Tyronn Lue on Chauncey Billups, Oct 3, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Jusuf Nurkic on Chauncey Billups
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Jusuf Nurkić:

“It's the best when both sides are happy. Going into free agency, I knew that I wanted to be here. With Chauncey, the relationship that we had, and with Joe taking over, I knew there was a high chance I'd come back.”

Jusuf Nurkic on Chauncey Billups, Jul 7, 2022. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Josh Hart on Chauncey Billups
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Josh Hart on Chauncey Billups:

“He's a players' coach. He does a great job of building you up, but a balance of holding you accountable. Off the court, he cares about you as a person.”

Josh Hart on Chauncey Billups, Apr 11, 2022. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Chauncey Billups, Damian Lillard
item.description:
Joe Cronin:

“Damian has been great. He communicates with Chauncey and I constantly. He's fully caught up with what our plans are and were and is very integral to what our plans are.”

Joe Cronin on Chauncey Billups, Damian Lillard, Feb 10, 2022. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Chauncey Billups
item.description:
Joe Cronin:

“It had become evident to us that the roster had plateaued. It was a team built to fit a specific coaching style and style of play that we didn't feel was conducive to the style Chauncey and myself wanted to play. We were looking at a team that was capped out.”

Joe Cronin on Chauncey Billups, Feb 10, 2022. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Jusuf Nurkic on Chauncey Billups
item.description:
“But I said I respect Chauncey enough to do it. I said, ‘I respect you as a person, as a player, as a coach, and whatever you ask of me, I’m going to do it.”

Jusuf Nurkic on Chauncey Billups, Jan 31, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Chauncey Billups
item.description:
“And he is the same guy today as he was then. The trust is there. I know Chauncey Billups as a person, I know exactly what that is, and I’m very lucky to have him.”

Joe Cronin on Chauncey Billups, Dec 14, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Chauncey Billups, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum
item.description:
Mark Medina:Blazers interim GM Joe Cronin on Damian Lillard & C.J. McCollum:

“They're happy with Chauncey and his staff. We know there's something we need to do with the roster, and we will.”

Joe Cronin on Chauncey Billups, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Dec 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Jusuf Nurkic on Chauncey Billups
item.description:
“He’s an ex-player. And to be honest, I was playing Chauncey in (the video game) 2K before I came to the NBA. Like, dead-ass truth. I don’t make shit up. But I feel like it’s a straight-up relationship. It’s especially what I need.”

Jusuf Nurkic on Chauncey Billups, Oct 31, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Chauncey Billups
item.description:
“It was just, ‘This is how much I want to win it.’ So,once it was time to come back and I had a conversation with Chauncey and had a conversation with Neil, I’m not going to come back halfhearted. I’m going to come back and be all in.”

Damian Lillard on Chauncey Billups, Oct 27, 2021. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Chauncey Billups
item.description:
“Ithink it’s a great opportunity for me to see something different and to learn. [Billups] knows the way to help myself and him, as a coach, to become a champion.”

Damian Lillard on Chauncey Billups, Oct 27, 2021. Source: NBA.com.
